name: CelesTrak GP Ingest Flow
description: Per-provider ingest flow (loop C.8a), GP catalog: a module cron TIMER tick enters at the request-builder node (celestrak-request:gp, URLs/timeout from node CONFIG), hostcap/http-request fetches the CSV, celestrak-parser:parse_gp normalizes it into OMM + MPE record streams with full SourceTags attribution (batch = sha256 of the payload) plus archive naming and wasm-authored provenance, and two hostcap/storage-ingest nodes persist the batches through the policy-mediated storage.ingest_with_source cap op (disk guardrail, pre/post duplicate reconcile, raw + provenance archiving host-side). Ingest results land on the egress sink. After each store, celestrak-request:publish_request joins that ingest result with the parser meta and (only when node CONFIG carries celestrak_publish_url) emits the loopback dataset-publication POST that a second hostcap/http-request node drives; the publication response also lands on the egress sink. All decisions live in-wasm; the host contributes timers, HTTP egress, and guarded persistence only.

externalInterfaces.description: Outbound HTTP through the host http.request hostcall. Go server host: 4 MiB response cap, 30 s default timeout. SDK NodeHost/BrowserHost: fetch-based, origin allowlists enforced by host policy.
Provenance/batch-capable record ingest through the host storage.ingest_with_source hostcall (sdn-server modulert/caps/storage.go).
